faqs.question: [REVIEW] How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on scope, so we give a written, itemised estimate after the Decide phase, before any build work is committed. Fixed-scope projects have a fixed price; dedicated teams are billed monthly.

faqs.question: [REVIEW] Who owns the code and designs?
faqs.answer: You do. Code lives in your repository from day one and intellectual property transfers to you on payment.

faqs.question: [REVIEW] Can we start small?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many clients start with a 2–4 week audit or a single feature, then decide whether to continue.

faqs.question: [REVIEW] Will you sign an NDA?
faqs.answer: Yes, before the scoping call if you like.

faqs.question: [REVIEW] What happens after launch?
faqs.answer: We hand over documentation and access, and can stay on for support and new features on a monthly basis.
